Zemax OpticStudio's OPD against WavefrontErrorCalculator's W, ray by ray, from `US8264785_Ex4_OPDC_Real.json`. Generated by `wfe parity --rays`.

- **Vignetting:** a dash marks a ray the program vignettes. "WFE only" or "program only" marks a ray vignetted in just one of the two.
